basis: The queue's starting corpus is kept unless another corpus that carries the same stroke count follows the dictionary's per-stroke directions more closely, as established in the grade 1 batch 24 re-review and used in the earlier special grade batches. Only differences that change the flagged-stroke count are acted on; a few degrees is noise.

蜩.reason: Ja writes the inner bars of the 周 body in a different order (two strokes over 60°, max 97°); MM follows the dictionary with no stroke over 27°.

搶.reason: Ja slants the opening dot of the 倉 body away from the dictionary (one stroke at 72°); MM follows the dictionary with no stroke over 18°.

鬻.reason: Ja writes the 弓 halves of the 鬲 frame in a different order (three strokes over 60°, max 146°); MM leaves two.

隼.reason: Ja writes the bars of 隹 in a different order (three strokes over 60°, max 97°); the simplified file leaves one, the top-right tick.

note: 倩 was considered for a Ja → Hans override on the flagged-stroke count (two against one), but the simplified and MM files write 青 with the two bars of 月 where the dictionary and Ja write 靑, closed by a single vertical. Form comes before the count, so the starting corpus was kept and the two flagged strokes were resolved by reordering instead.
